title: Restaurant Platform
subtitle: QR menu and table ordering for restaurants.
description: A multi-language QR menu and table ordering system. Guests order from their table, staff follow orders on a live board, and owners edit the menu with two-factor protection. Data rules are enforced in the database and were tested on a test project. A pilot with real restaurants is planned.
